description: Cap or floor volatility quote in year fractions for the direct Hull-White calibrators.

is_cap.description: `true` for a cap, `false` for a floor.

is_normal_vol.description: `true` for normal (Bachelier) vol. Lognormal cap/floor quotes are rejected.

maturity.description: Cap/floor maturity in years from the curve base date; finite and positive.

strike.description: Strike rate as a decimal (for example `0.03` for 3%).

volatility.description:
Market-quoted flat volatility; normal vols use decimal rate units
(`0.0088` is 88 bp). Finite and positive.

title: Hull-White Cap/Floor Quote
